rationale: The supplied complete text 116 ends at verse 82, so 116/90 does not exist. The exact example “mqarawno u darbayḏi” is in 111/64; 111/72 and 111/75 also concern shortening the same journey. Retain those existing references. The automatic suggestion 116/65 does not contain the quotation.

summary: Restore the concessive meaning of məqqa d-howe
before: He understood: what a sinner should be the priest if the Holy Spirit descends upon his host when he celebrates mass
after: He understood that, however sinful the priest may be, the Holy Spirit descends upon his offering when he celebrates Mass
rationale: The Turoyo “d-məqqa d-howe u=kuhno ḥaṭoyo” is concessive: however sinful the priest may be. The current “what a sinner should be the priest if” changes this into a question or conditional inference. The edition confirms “so sehr der Priester ein Sünder sein mag”.

The example says “qariwo l-i=dukṯ-ayḏe”, near his dwelling-place. In 26/101–102 the tribe was near his dwelling; the quotation itself expresses spatial proximity, sense 1, rather than kinship, sense 2.

summary: Move the temporal-proximity example to stem I, Participle, sense 1
rationale: The relevant form qariwo means near, here near midday, as confirmed by 44/91. Stem I already has a Participle box illustrating qariwo with near a sowing-time and near the village. This is neither a stem-II infinitive nor sense II.3, celebrating Mass. The following qrele means called and is not the target verb qrw.
